sources.citation: Robert L. Spitzer (1975). On pseudoscience in science, logic in remission, and psychiatric diagnosis: A critique of Rosenhan's "On being sane in insane places". Journal of Abnormal Psychology.
sources.notes: Foundational methodological critique by DSM-III architect Robert Spitzer analyzing discharge diagnoses ('in remission') and motivating operationalized diagnostic criteria.
